mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 62 degrees with overcast skies at the Verona Public Library under a waxing crescent moon. If you are up early, you can catch the International Space Station at 5:35 AM as it rises over Mount Horeb and heads toward the Fitchburg and Madison area, passing nearly directly overhead.

The city has finalized the winners of the I Voted sticker contest, with Elijah, Azelie, June, and Samantha taking home the prizes for their designs. Also, please note that the City Council has approved adjustments to sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our infrastructure remains self-supporting and prevents future flooding or system failures.

There is plenty happening in town. Today, check out the Epic User Group Meeting or enjoy trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, we have live music and trivia at Paddy Mac's, plus yoga at Insight Wellness and the Downtown Farmer's Market.

In a recent report from August 15, an officer pulled over a driver near North Main Street and Cross Country Road after observing the vehicle swerving. The driver was subsequently arrested for a first offence O W I.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Chocolate Pecan. Since the store is currently closed, you can stop by when they open at 10:00 AM. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Double Strawberry flavor.
